name: Celebrating KS Nisar Ahmed : Through poetry and song
description:
Celebrating KS Nisar Ahmed

Through poetry and song

with

Roopa Pai : Author of 'Every Day is a Celebration' - a translation of selected works of KS Nisar Ahmed

and

Mangala Karthik : A Classical Carnatic Vocalist and Educator.

Sumana Chandrashekar : Ghatam

Jyotsna Hebbar : Veena

About the Event

On the occasion of Kannada Rajyotsava we celebrate one of Karnataka's most beloved poets

Padma Shri KS Nisar Ahmed 

Every Day a Celebration, a new book of translation of Nisar Ahmed's poetry, gathers some of his finest poems, spanning more than five decades, and introduces his voice to a wider audience through Roopa Pai’s sensitive translation. English readers can now experience the brilliance of a Kannada poet whose voice continues to resonate with urgency and humanity.

This special event brings his poetry to life as bestselling author Roopa Pai reads from her English translations of his finest work, while celebrated classical vocalist Mangala Karthik and her musical ensemble perform these iconic verses live as beautiful melodies.

About Roopa Pai

Roopa Pai is an acclaimed Bengaluru-based author, journalist, and cultural chronicler widely celebrated for making complex philosophies, histories, and literatures deeply accessible to readers.

While she is a prolific creator of children's fantasy and non-fiction, her role as a translator shines brightly in Every Day a Celebration—her landmark debut translation project. Driven by a lifelong passion for her city and its regional heritage, she delicately translates five decades of stirring Kannada verse by the iconic poet K. S. Nisar Ahmed, bridging cultural gaps to allow English-speaking audiences to experience the soul and lyrical beauty of Karnataka's literary giant. This book beautifully reflects her broader life's work as a bridge-builder of heritage: whether she is simplifying ancient Indian scriptures like The Gita, unearthing local history through her tour company BangaloreWalks, or translating evocative local poetry, her writing constantly seeks to make profound human experiences feel intimate, relevant, and alive.

 

About Mangala Karthik

Mangala Karthik is a Carnatic vocalist, teacher, and co-founder of the Anandi Centre for Music in Bangalore. A disciple of the legendary violinist Padmabhushan Lalgudi Jayaraman and renowned teacher Sangeetha Kalacharya Neela Ramgopal, she brings exceptional pedigree and depth to her music. She is passionate about making classical music accessible to all and has served as a radio jockey, music interviewer, and writer alongside her performance career. Her teaching philosophy emphasises removing jargon and enabling students to experience the joy of Carnatic music at every level.

 

 

 

About Sumana Chandrashekar

Sumana Chandrashekar is a Bengaluru-based Carnatic percussionist, researcher, and author who stands out as one of the few prominent female players of the ghatam (clay pot). After starting her musical journey as a vocalist, she shifted to percussion in her late twenties following a recurring, vivid dream about the clay pot. She went on to train under trailblazing gurus Vidushi Sukanya Ramgopal and T.H. 'Vikku' Vinayakram, even learning the traditional craft of pot-making in Manamadurai to deepen her connection to the instrument. Known for her ambidextrous playing style and signature performance turban, she detailed her artistic journey and confronted systemic patriarchy in classical music within her acclaimed memoir, Song of the Clay Pot.

About Jyotsna Hebbar

Jyothsna Hebbar is an accomplished Indian Carnatic classical musician from Bengaluru, known for her rare mastery as both a Vainika (Veena player) and a Mridangam percussionist. She received rigorous training under her mother, Vidushi Smt. Jyothi Chetan (for Veena), and Vidwan Shri H. S. Sudhindra (for Mridangam). A recipient of the prestigious CCRT cultural scholarship, she has won top prizes at the Madras Music Academy and the Bangalore Gayana Samaja.

name: Meet Niyatee Sharma : Funky Rainbow
description:
COURTYARD KOOTA in association with FUNKY RAINBOW

presents

MEET NIYATEE SHARMA

Session Duration: 1 and a half hours (11:00am to 12:30pm)

Recommended Audience: 5+ years and adults of all ages

Books in Focus: The Tomato Thief and The Tomato Flood (both published by Tota Books)

 

ABOUT THE SESSION

Veer cannot wait to taste the tomatoes growing in his terrace garden. When the tomatoes are just ripe enough to pick, something strange happens. The tomatoes go missing. Join author Niyatee Sharma as she helps Veer solve the mystery and find out who is stealing his delicious tomatoes! Then, do a fun fold-out drawing activity!

 

ABOUT NIYATEE SHARMA

Niyatee Sharma is a children’s author based in Bengaluru. An interior architect by training, Niyatee combines her love for writing and her expertise in design to create much-loved books for children. Some of her books have been on the Parag Honour List, the Toka Box Top South Asian Picture Books Awards, the Jarul Book Awards and the Green Literature Festival Honour Books longlists.

An avid gardener, Niyatee grows vegetables and fruits in her terrace garden, and, through her books, she wants to inspire children to grow their own food. She loves to explore the green pockets of her city – by clicking, sketching and collecting.

 

BOOKS BY THE AUTHOR

The Tomato Thief (Rs. 275); The Tomato Flood (Rs. 250); What Can I Be? (Rs. 225); Harvest Day (Rs. 225); A Bounty of Chillies (Rs. 250) (all published by Tota Books)

Mahalaxmi Will Go to Mysore (Rs. 199); A Whole Lot of School Stories (Rs. 399) (both published by Duckbill)

The Runaway Peacock (Rs. 195) (published by Tulika)

My Nest is the Best (Rs. 170) (published by Kalpavriksh)

Rocket Champs (Rs. 299) (published by Scholastic)

Perfect the Way You Are! (Rs. 299) (published by Daffodil Lane Books)

 

NOTE FOR THE PARENTS

The Meet-the-Author sessions conducted at Courtyard Koota in association with Funky Rainbow are a unique opportunity for you and your child to meet some of India’s most popular creators of children’s books. Funky Rainbow, Bangalore’s Beloved Independent Children’s Bookstore, will put up books of the visiting author for sale at the venue at the time of the session. Give your child the unforgettable experience of getting autographed copies of their books!

 

ABOUT FUNKY RAINBOW

Funky Rainbow is a Bangalore-based independent children’s bookshop and book consultancy run by children’s writers, illustrators, storytellers and creative professionals with the aim of introducing books to young audiences. Our books are handpicked and curated for children in the age-group of 0-18 years and represent the best of Indian children’s writing. The bookshop carries a mix of both fiction and non-fiction titles (in the price range of 50rs to 500rs) that are not easily available in mainstream bookstores. Funky Rainbow recently expanded its presence by opening its second bookshop in Mysore in July 2025.
